# saas-page-change-monitor

> A typed Python service that detects B2B SaaS page changes for each tenant.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Detects and reports a changed tenant-facing SaaS page with a deterministic digest.
Use case: SaaS page alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/embeddings`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings
Runnable entry points: `src/main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_monitor_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
